description: This file declares the interface for a WebSocket server component, including configuration structures, API functions for initialization, starting, message queuing, server enabling/disabling, and endpoint management.

methods.name: WSSERVER_Start
methods.description: Starts the WebSocket server to accept connections.

methods.name: WSSERVER_QueueBinaryMessage
methods.description: Enqueues a binary message to be sent over a specific connection, with an expiry time.

methods.name: WSSERVER_Main
methods.description: Main loop or thread function for the WebSocket server.

methods.name: WSSERVER_EnableServer
methods.description: Configures and activates the WebSocket server with specified settings.

methods.name: WSSERVER_DisableServer
methods.description: Disables the WebSocket server, closing active connections.

methods.name: WSSERVER_ActivateScheduledActions
methods.description: Performs scheduled actions related to the WebSocket server.

methods.name: WSSERVER_GetMtpStatus
methods.description: Retrieves the overall status of the MTP subsystem.

methods.name: WSSERVER_DisconnectEndpoint
methods.description: Disconnects a specific endpoint based on its ID.

methods.name: WSSERVER_GetMTPForEndpointId
methods.description: Retrieves the MTP connection info for a given endpoint ID.

ctags.name: enable_encryption
ctags.pattern: /^    bool enable_encryption;     \/\/ set if the server should use TLS connections$/

ctags.name: keep_alive
ctags.pattern: /^    unsigned keep_alive;        \/\/ Keep alive interval (in seconds)$/

ctags.name: path
ctags.pattern: /^    char *path;                 \/\/ resource path in the URL to the websocket server$/

ctags.name: port
ctags.pattern: /^    unsigned port;              \/\/ port to listen on$/
